body:
## Summary

`MATRIX` in `src/bos/domain/contradiction/matrix.ts:3-82` claims to be the "Classic Altshuller 39x39 Contradiction Matrix (upper triangular)", but the rows are misaligned. `lookup()` (matrix.ts:111-137) indexes `row[worsening - 1]` with no shape validation, so it returns the cell for the **wrong column** for most pairs.

Verified programmatically against the current source:

1. **Leading-empties drift.** In a correct upper-triangular matrix, row `p` must have exactly `p` leading empty cells (worsening 1..p) then data for `p+1..39` — total 39. Actual:
   - Rows 1-3: 37 cells (columns 38-39 missing)
   - Row 4: 7 leading empties (should be 4) — data starts 3 columns late
   - Rows 7-39: `p+2` leading empties — every data cell reads as if it belonged to the pair `w-2`
   - Rows 13-39: 41-44 cells; the trailing extras are unreachable (index > 38)
2. **150/741 pairs (20.2%) silently return `[]`** (e.g. `1,38`, `2,38`, `3,38`, `4,5`, `4,6`...).
3. **4 of the file's own `CANONICAL_OVERRIDES` (documented as canonical Altshuller values, matrix.ts:87-99) are shadowed by misaligned non-empty cells:**

   | pair | lookup returns | canonical override says |
   |------|---------------|------------------------|
   | 19,22 | [7,2,35,39] | [12,19,28,2] |
   | 22,25 | [21,35,2,39] | [10,35,13,2] |
   | 22,26 | [21,35,2,39] (duplicate of 22,25!) | [10,35,11,2] |
   | 22,27 | [35,2,39,21] | [10,35,2,13] |

## Impact

Silent wrong results everywhere the matrix is used: `triz_contradiction` (lookup + analyze via `AnalyzeContradictionHandler`), the `/contradiction` slash command, and the ARIZ engine's matrix pass (`src/bos/domain/ariz/engine.ts:81`). No test asserts row shape, so this never fails CI.

## Fix

Regenerate the 39x39 matrix from a verified Altshuller source (row `p` = `p` leading empties + `39-p` data cells, exactly 39 cells per row) and resolve the override/cell contradictions. Add a unit test asserting for every row: `cells.length === 39`, first `p` cells empty, values in 1-40, plus the canonical spot-checks above.
title: Contradiction matrix data is structurally broken: wrong-column lookups for most pairs, 20% silently empty, own canonical overrides shadowed
